verdict.rationale: TeamViewer ships its own AI agent (Tia) and AI troubleshooting assistant, so letting users plug external MCP servers into it is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the evidence pack shows MCP client support or any way to attach external tool servers. The Web API and AI features are adjacent capabilities, not MCP client integration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
